sloka: हम्स सरस सम्घुष्टाम् चक्र वाक उपकूजिताम् ।सदामदैश्च विहगैरभिसम्नादिताम् तराम् ॥२-५०-१९॥
transliteration: hamsa sarasa samghuṣṭām cakra vāka upakūjitām ।sadāmadaiśca vihagairabhisamnāditām tarām ॥2-50-19॥

translations.english: The river reverberates with the cries of swans, cranes and chakravakas (ruddy goose). It rings intermittently with the chirpings of birds charged with endless pasison.
